snippet.title: What Happens When 4 Players Share 1 Wallet? | Gamble Hunters - Gameplay Overview
snippet.description:
Experiment: what happens when four people share one wallet? ...In a casino.

Rule 1: First to spend it, owns it.
Rule 2: Stop everyone else from spending.
Rule 3: Monitor your teammates' efficiency.

Gamble Hunters is a first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players.
Hunt monsters together, fill the shared wallet, then race your friends to the casino and turn it into your own Gold. Spend it on weapon upgrades, skill trees and artifacts. Just don't forget the debt.

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5117630
🎬 Official Gameplay Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hc-PwiV_MIc

All bets use in-game virtual currency only. No real-money gambling, no additional purchases.

#GambleHunters #coopgame #indiegame
